title: Learning: Prove What You Are
text: A workload asks for the billing identity, calls the ledger through the mesh, and the ledger answers. Each hop can look before it trusts.
held: The identity went to the real billing workload, the call was one policy allows, and the ledger saw a valid certificate.

cards.label: Refuse to issue
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: attested as
fields.value: the billing image, under billing's service account
fields.check: Attest the workload: what is actually running?
fields.ok: The node agent confirms the billing image, running under billing's service account.

intrusion.value: an unknown image in a debug pod
intrusion.detail: The node agent reports an unrecognised image in a debug pod.
intrusion.why: Issuing on a name alone gives the billing identity to whatever asks for it. Attestation is the difference between a name and an identity.
intrusion.reveal: The workload asking for billing's identity was an unknown image in a debug pod.

temptations.label: Issue now and attest at the first renewal
temptations.why: For that first hour an unverified workload holds a real identity. An hour is plenty.

cards.label: Block the call
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: policy for this call
fields.value: allowed: billing may read the ledger
fields.check: Look up the policy for this caller and this action

intrusion.value: not allowed: this is a write, and billing may only read
intrusion.detail: Billing may read the ledger. This call is a write.
intrusion.why: Billing was who it said it was, and still had no business writing to the ledger. Identity is not permission.
intrusion.reveal: The call from billing was a write, which policy does not allow.

cards.label: Refuse the request
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

intrusion.detail: The certificate expired three hours ago.
intrusion.why: An expired identity is exactly what a thief is left holding. Honouring it makes the expiry meaningless.
intrusion.reveal: The certificate presented to the Service had expired three hours earlier.

teaches: The issuer checks what is running before it issues. A name in a request is only a claim.
Authentication answers who; policy answers whether this caller may do this.
Expiry is a control only if the receiver enforces it.
